6409-how-to-speak-and-write-correctly.description: A book by Joseph Devlin, M.A.. Grammar, and Composition. To them such works are as gold enclosed in chests of steel and locked beyond power of opening. This book has no pretension about it whatever,--it is neither a Manual of Rhetoric, expatiating on the dogmas of style, nor a Grammar full of arbitrary rules and exceptions.

arxiv-2008-08821.creator: Alessio Arleo, Walter Didimo, Giuseppe Liotta, Silvia Miksch, Fabrizio Montecchiani
arxiv-2008-08821.description: Abstract In social networks, individuals’ decisions are strongly influenced by recommendations from their friends and acquaintances. The influence maximization (IM) problem asks to select a seed set of users that maximizes the influence spread, i.e., the expected number of users influenced through a stochastic diffusion process triggered by the seeds.

arxiv-2203-02628.title: Target Network and Truncation Overcome the Deadly Triad in Q Q -learning
arxiv-2203-02628.creator: Zaiwei Chenlabel=e1, mark]zchen458@gatech.edu, John-Paul Clarkelabel=e2, mark]johnpaul@utexas.edu, Siva Theja Magulurilabel=e3, mark]siva.theja@gatech.edu
arxiv-2203-02628.description: Abstract Q Q -learning with function approximation is one of the most empirically successful while theoretically mysterious reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms, and was identified in Sutton 1999 as one of the most important theoretical open problems in the RL community. Even in the basic linear function approximation setting, there are well-known divergent examples.

arxiv-2301-01222.title: A Multi-Source Information Learning Framework for Airbnb Price Prediction
arxiv-2301-01222.creator: Lu Jiang 1 , Yuanhan Li 1 , Na Luo 1 , Jianan Wang 2,∗ , Qiao Ning 3,∗
arxiv-2301-01222.description: Abstract With the development of technology and sharing economy, Airbnb as a famous short-term rental platform, has become the first choice for many young people to select. The issue of Airbnb’s pricing has always been a problem worth studying. While the previous studies achieve promising results, there are exists deficiencies to solve.

arxiv-2312-04074.title: Inner bounding the quantum entropy cone with subadditivity and subsystem coarse grainings
arxiv-2312-04074.creator: Temple He, Veronika E. Hubeny, Massimiliano Rota
arxiv-2312-04074.description: Abstract We show via explicit construction that all the extreme rays of both the three-party quantum entropy cone and the four-party stabilizer entropy cone can be obtained from subsystem coarse grainings of specific higher-party quantum states, namely extreme states characterized by saturating a (non-trivial) maximal set of instances of subadditivity.

arxiv-2412-18942.title: Multipolar Ferroelectricity in the Mott Regime
arxiv-2412-18942.creator: Pengwei Zhao †, Jiahao Yang †, Gang v. Chen
arxiv-2412-18942.description: Abstract Ferroelectricity has been one major focus in modern fundamental research and technological application. We consider the physical origin of improper ferroelectricity in Mott insulating materials. Beyond the well-known Katsura-Nagaosa-Balatsky’s inverse Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya mechanism for the noncollinearly ordered magnets, we point out the induction of the electric polarizations in the multipolar ordered Mott insulators.

europmc-pmc3464226.title: Seasonal pulses of Marburg virus circulation in juvenile Rousettus aegyptiacus bats coincide with periods of increased risk of human infection.
europmc-pmc3464226.creator: Amman BR, Carroll SA, Reed ZD, Sealy TK, Balinandi S, Swanepoel R, Kemp A, Erickson BR, Comer JA, Campbell S, Cannon DL, Khristova ML, Atimnedi P, Paddock CD, Crockett RJ, Flietstra TD, Warfield KL, Unfer R, Katongole-Mbidde E, Downing R, Tappero JW, Zaki SR, Rollin PE, Ksiazek TG, Nichol ST, Towner JS.
europmc-pmc3464226.description: Marburg virus (family Filoviridae) causes sporadic outbreaks of severe hemorrhagic disease in sub-Saharan Africa. Bats have been implicated as likely natural reservoir hosts based most recently on an investigation of cases among miners infected in 2007 at the Kitaka mine,...

pmc-10621163.title: Regular soccer training improves pulmonary diffusion capacity in 6 to 10 year old boys
pmc-10621163.creator: Rim Dridi, Nadia Dridi, Nabil Gmada, Ismail Laher, Ayoub Saeidi, Urs Granacher, Hassane Zouhal
pmc-10621163.description: BackgroundSoccer is one of the most attractive sports around the globe for children and adolescents, and the benefits of soccer training are often shown. Due to the intermittent character of soccer with random changes between high-intensity activity and low-intensity play, athletes’ aerobic (respiratory) capacity is specifically stimulated.

pmc-10631823.title: Nitrofurantoin: what is the evidence for current UK guidance?
pmc-10631823.creator: Eleanor Kashouris, Amelia Joseph, Tom Lewis
pmc-10631823.description: Three days of nitrofurantoin at 100 mg twice daily is recommended as first-line treatment for uncomplicated urinary tract infection (UTI) in evidence-based guidelines across the UK. A review of international guidelines shows that the evidence base has been interpreted in very different ways.

pmc-10665174.title: Spatiotemporal epidemiology and risk factors of scrub typhus in Hainan Province, China, 2011–2020
pmc-10665174.creator: Lisha Liu, Yang Xiao, Xianyu Wei, Xuan Li, Chunyuan Duan, Xinjing Jia, Ruizhong Jia, Jinpeng Guo, Yong Chen, Xiushan Zhang, Wenyi Zhang, Yong Wang
pmc-10665174.description: BackgroundThe re-emergence of scrub typhus in the southern provinces of China in recent decades has been validated, thereby attracting the attention of public health authorities. There has been a spatial and temporal expansion of scrub typhus in Hainan Province, but the epidemiological characteristics, environmental drivers, and potential high-risk areas for scrub typhus have not yet been investigated.

pmc-10672596.title: Second Generation Long-Acting Injectable Antipsychotics in Schizophrenia: The Patient’s Subjective Quality of Life, Well-Being, and Satisfaction
pmc-10672596.creator: Claudio Brasso, Silvio Bellino, Paola Bozzatello, Cristiana Montemagni, Marco Giuseppe Alberto Nobili, Rodolfo Sgro, Paola Rocca, Carlos M Opazo
pmc-10672596.description: Schizophrenia (SZ) is among the twenty most disabling diseases worldwide. Subjective quality of life, well-being, and satisfaction are core elements to achieving personal recovery from the disorder. Long-acting injectable second-generation antipsychotics (SGA-LAIs) represent a valid therapeutic option for the treatment of SZ as they guarantee good efficacy and adherence to treatment.

pmc-11436986.title: Exposing disparities in flood adaptation for equitable future interventions in the USA
pmc-11436986.creator: Lidia Cano Pecharroman, ChangHoon Hahn
pmc-11436986.description: As governments race to implement new climate adaptation solutions that prepare for more frequent flooding, they must seek policies that are effective for all communities and uphold climate justice. This requires evaluating policies not only on their overall effectiveness but also on whether they benefit all communities.

pmc-11484767.title: Optimizing Treatment Strategies for Carbapenem-Resistant Acinetobacter Baumannii-Associated Pneumonia: A Multicenter Study in Chinese Hospitals
pmc-11484767.creator: Xiaotong Tian, Jing Lin, Menglan Zhou, Ying Ge, Taisheng Li, Li Zhang, Zhengyin Liu
pmc-11484767.description: PurposeTo evaluate the clinical outcomes and safety of tigecycline (TGC) plus cefoperazone/sulbactam (CPS) or TGC monotherapy in patients with hospital-acquired pneumonia (HAP) caused by Carbapenem-Resistant Acinetobacter baumannii (CRAB).MethodsThis was a retrospective analysis of multicenter data from 62 Chinese hospitals with CRAB HAP.

pmc-11648879.title: On the control of cell proliferation
pmc-11648879.creator: D. Thirumalai, Rajsekhar Das, Xin Li
pmc-11648879.description: he factors that control intercellular contacts resulting in cell proliferation across various tissues has not emerged. Contacts between cells are influenced not only by biochemical signaling pathways (3) but also by the mechanical forces arising from interactions with the environment (4).

pmc-11860219.title: Unitarity or multiplicity of the psychosis: neverending question in psychopathology.
pmc-11860219.creator: J. J. Martínez Jambrina
pmc-11860219.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Introduction Introduce the topic of the continuity of psychoses and its relevance in contemporary psychiatry. Present authors as Henry EY, Jim van Os and Germán Berrios as key figures in the discussion on this topic, highlighting Ey, Dr. Jim van Os’s significant contributions to the understanding of the continuum of psychosis, Germán Berrios’s historical and cultural perspectives, and the importance of Bartolomé Llopis’s critical viewpoint. We also review the evolutionary approach about mental disorders as a keypoint in this discussion.

pmc-12455937.title: Interaction of West Nile virus NS5 with orthoflavivirus SLA RNAs and their effects on viral replication and inhibition
pmc-12455937.creator: Mandi A. Feinberg, My T. Le, Kassandra L. Carpio, Ekaterina Knyazhanskaya, Alan D. T. Barrett, Kyung H. Choi
pmc-12455937.description: West Nile virus (WNV) is a single-stranded, positive-sense RNA virus in the Orthoflavivirus genus, within Flaviviridae. The genus encompasses numerous pathogens of public health importance, including WNV, dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), and Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV). Orthoflavivirus replication depends on the presence of the stem-loop A (SLA) structure in the 5′ untranslated region of the genome.

pmc-12504701.title: Cut the fat: targeting cholesterol and lipid metabolism in glioblastoma
pmc-12504701.creator: Safet Zekanovic, Puspha Achaiber Sing, Sieger Leenstra, Martine L M Lamfers
pmc-12504701.description: In the past decades, much research has been focused on identifying oncogenic signaling events in glioblastoma (GBM). Based on these findings, novel therapeutics have been extensively tested in clinical trials. These include targeted agents (e.g., kinase inhibitors), anti-angiogenic drugs, and immunotherapies. Unfortunately, no survival benefit has been demonstrated with the use of these agents.

pmc-12730780.title: Intra-Articular Injection of Adipose-Derived-MSC Exosomes and Hyaluronic Acid in Sheep Knee Osteoarthritic Models Enhances Hyaline Cartilage Regeneration
pmc-12730780.creator: Auliya Akbar, Ismail Hadisoebroto Dilogo, Radiana Dhewayani Antarianto, Iqra Kousar, Angela Jennifer Tantry, Anissa Feby Canintika, Elisa Belluzzi
pmc-12730780.description: Background: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a degenerative joint disease characterized by cartilage damage. The limited regenerative capability of articular cartilage poses a therapeutic challenge. Adipose mesenchymal stem cell (MSC) exosomes have shown potential in regenerating cartilage structure in previous in vivo studies on small animals.

pmc-13108234.title: The Potential Role of Baseline FT3/FT4 Ratio as a Prognostic Biomarker for Patients With Ischemic Non‐Obstructive Coronary Artery Disease
pmc-13108234.creator: Feipeng Wu, Xiandong Zheng, Liju Hong, Qiyan Wu, Rui Yang, Xiaodong Xie, Weijia Ren, Zijian Cai, Yuanyuan Xiao, Youjun Zhou
pmc-13108234.description: BackgroundIschemia with non‐obstructive coronary artery disease (INOCA) is associated with an increased risk of major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE). The relationship between thyroid function and the progression of INOCA remains unclear. This study aims to evaluate the prognostic value of the ratio of serum free triiodothyronine (FT3) to free thyroxine (FT4) in patients with INOCA.

pmc-13319689.title: Association of the apolipoproteins with retinal arteriosclerosis in a health examination population
pmc-13319689.creator: Xinghe Sun, Lijuan Guo, Hui Lv, Xian Zhang, Chaoqun Wu, Xiaohui Liu

pmc-13637149.title: Enhancing semantic interoperability in precision medicine: converting OMOP CDM to Beacon v2 in the Spanish IMPaCT-Data project
pmc-13637149.creator: Manuel Rueda, Juan Manuel Ramírez-Anguita, Victoria López-Sánchez, Sergi Aguiló-Castillo, Maria Eugenia Gas López, Alberto Labarga, Miguel-Ángel Mayer, Javier Ripoll Esteve, Ivo G Gut
pmc-13637149.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate a file-based approach for converting OMOP CDM data into GA4GH Beacon v2 format and outline an alternative on-the-fly architecture for real-time access, with the aim of enhancing semantic interoperability within Spain’s IMPaCT-Data program for personalized medicine.Materials and methodsWe used the Convert-Pheno tool to transform OMOP CDM exports into Beacon v2 format using a file-based approach.
